title: What if gravity kept growing?
idea: Fact what-if 02: gravity gets stronger every five seconds (1-5 g, then 5 g steps to 50 g): you black out, then the world breaks through the window, then back to 1 g and the phone loops.

hook.what: you on the sofa, phone over your face, the counter at 1 g and the question on screen; at 1.0 s hand and phone slam onto his face

props.staged: the glass tower across the street, its base on the city ground 60 m below
the city outside: 136 buildings, ground, dust sea; collapses at 20 g, erased by the Moon's wave
the street below the window tearing open, cars, fires
satellites and the space station burning in, kilometres up
three falling satellites hitting the city
the Alps valley, 40 km away in its own sky
the Moon falling onto the Earth
the impact's fire wall racing across the city
the window blown in: glass, wood, stuffing, the shelf
a white flash on the camera lens
a black card on the camera lens (tunnel vision)
a black card on the camera lens (the black after the hit)

captions.text: Every five seconds, gravity gets stronger. In ten, you black out.
Four g. Your eyes go grey.
Five g. Most people black out here.
Ten g. Lying flat, your blood comes back.
Fifteen. Buildings only hold about twice their weight.
Twenty. The whole city comes down.
Twenty-five. No human survives this. Good thing you're a potato.
Thirty. Every satellite falls out of the sky.
Thirty-five. The air itself turns poisonous.
Forty. Mountains crush under their own weight.
Forty-five. Even the Moon is falling.
Fifty. Seventeen hours later, it hits.

visible.why: frame 0: you on the sofa, the phone held over your face; the counter reads 1 g
2 g: hand and phone slam onto his face
3 g: teeth gritted, pressed into the cushion
4 g: grey picture, heavy lids
5 g: the picture closes to a hole on his face
he has blacked out, slumped back on the sofa
10 g: awake again, pressed flat; the sofa legs splay and the floor cracks
15 g: the glass tower across the street cracks and collapses straight down in dust
20 g: behind him every building in the city crushes down into a sea of dust
25 g: from the window, the street below tears open, cars crushed at its lips, fires
25 g: pancake flat, a calm wink on 'Good thing you're a potato'
30 g: every satellite falls, fireballs fill the sky, the space station breaks apart
30 g: a satellite hits the city: flash, a ring of dust, the window cracks
35 g: the cracked window over the flattened, burning city
35 g: the air thickens to a haze, he gasps
40 g: real mountains: cliffs fail, avalanches pour into the valley
40 g: a summit splits in two, house-sized blocks fly
45 g: the Moon falls, cracking, burning chunks breaking off
50 g: he stares up at it
50 g: the Moon fills the sky over the ruins
50 g: the Moon hits behind the city, a wall of fire races at the window
50 g: the window explodes inward, glass and furniture fly over him, white flash
1 g again: the room is whole, the phone back up in his hand (the loop)

allowClip.reason: the gag: 2 g slams his own hand and the phone onto his face, one eye under the phone for half a second
he sits sunk into the sofa: gravity presses him into the cushion (the dip is drawn by the sofa's sink); his widening body spreads into the seat and back cushion
25 g: pancake flat, his rolled collar spreads over his mouth; the wink (the payoff) is in the eyes, which stay clear
